text_markup: Players are not required to and should not reveal an installed card to verify that it meets server limitations.
text_plain: Players are not required to and should not reveal an installed card to verify that it meets server limitations.

examples.text_markup: The Corp installs a card in the root of a server with a rezzed {subtype:region} upgrade. The new card cannot also be a {subtype:region} upgrade (unless the old one is trashed as part of the installation), as per {ref:subsec_regions}. They do not reveal the installed card to verify this.
examples.text_plain: The Corp installs a card in the root of a server with a rezzed region upgrade. The new card cannot also be a region upgrade (unless the old one is trashed as part of the installation), as per section 3.6.5. They do not reveal the installed card to verify this.
